### Solutions

- **[id 200]**: Baldur fetches $5 + 6 = 11$ pails per day. At $5\text{ liters/pail}$, total liters per day $= 11 \times 5 = 55$.
- **[id 201]**: A $5\%$ raise on $\$2000/\text{week}$ gives $\$2100/\text{week}$. Over 52 weeks, earnings are $52 \times 2100 = \$109,200$. Adding the $\$5000$ award gives $109200 + 5000 = 114200$.
- **[id 202]**: $10\text{ acres} \times 5\text{ tons/acre} = 50\text{ tons}$. At $2\text{ barrels/ton}$, total wine $= 50 \times 2 = 100\text{ barrels}$.
- **[id 203]**: Lunch sandwiches: $7 \times 2 = 14\text{ slices}$. Breakfast omelets: $3 \times (2 + 1) = 9\text{ slices}$. Macaroni and cheese: $8\text{ slices}$. Total slices $= 14 + 9 + 8 = 31$.
- **[id 204]**: Initial pens: $22 + 10 = 32$. Blue pens: $6 \times 9 = 54$. Red pens: $2 \times 6 = 12$. Total pens $= 32 + 54 + 12 = 98$.
- **[id 205]**: To average $93$ across the top 5 scores, the required sum is $5 \times 93 = 465$. The top four scores from the first five tests are $86, 89, 92, 100$ (sum $= 367$), dropping the lowest score ($71$). The required score on the sixth test is $465 - 367 = 98$.
- **[id 206]**: First period: $4\text{ weeks} \times 5\text{ rides/week} \times 25\text{ km} = 500\text{ km}$. Second period: $3\text{ weeks} \times 2\text{ rides/week} \times 60\text{ km} = 360\text{ km}$. Total distance $= 500 + 360 = 860\text{ km}$.
- **[id 207]**: Each chocolate bar is $40\text{ g}$, so each candied apple is $40 / 2 = 20\text{ g}$. Total weight $= (25 \times 40) + (80 \times 20) = 1000 + 1600 = 2600\text{ g}$.
- **[id 208]**: Monday: $4\text{ cakes}$. Tuesday: $3 \times 4 = 12\text{ cakes}$. Wednesday: $5 \times 12 = 60\text{ cakes}$. Total cakes $= 4 + 12 + 60 = 76$.
- **[id 209]**: Half a dozen plates cost $6 \times 6000 = \$36,000$. 20 dozen cups cost $36000 - 1200 = \$34,800$. Total cups $= 20 \times 12 = 240$. Cost per cup $= 34800 / 240 = 145$.
